<translate>
The '''Brave Sword''' is an all-round blade that uses the balanced '''sword''' moveset, with a reach of 2.5 blocks. You get it as a wish from [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], and it is the weapon you need for the [[Special:MyLanguage/Shining Sword Attack|Shining Sword Attack]] technique.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

Gather the seven Namek Dragon Balls, summon Porunga and choose the '''Brave Sword''' wish (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Fighting with it ==

* '''Moveset:''' sword, a balanced combo with a reach of 2.5 blocks.
* '''Critical hits:''' 10% chance, 15% critical damage.
* It has 2,600 durability.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Shining Sword Attack|Shining Sword Attack]], a strike attack taught by Trunks, can only be used while you hold the Brave Sword (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Attacks|Strike Attacks]]).
* While you carry it in your inventory, it is shown on your character's back.

See [[Special:MyLanguage/Special Weapons|Special Weapons]] for how movesets, combos, blocking and parrying work.
</translate>
